A [[Charr Bag]] is an equippable item that provides 10 additional inventory spaces. Because they already hold 10 items, they ''cannot'' be upgraded by using a [[Rune of Holding]]. A [[Superior Rune of Holding]] can be applied to it after leaving [[Pre-Searing]] and make it hold 15 items. A character may wear up to 2 bags at one time. Bags are not visible to other players.

Charr Bags are most commonly used by players in Pre-Searing who, without access to [[storage]], have little [[inventory]] space.

== Notes ==
* Charr Bags use the same inventory icon as [[Jun's Art Supplies]], [[Tasca's Pack]], and [[Zehtuka's Pack]].
* They appear to have the same model as the backpacks carried by some [[Merchant]]s.
* This item cannot be dyed.
* Empty bags can be moved into other, equipped bags, or into your [[storage]], but as with any other [[container]], they cannot be unequipped until you remove all [[item]]s.
